Implemented and compiled successfully (CODESYS 3.5, 0 errors, 0 warnings) for PUB017 Recipe Management System.

Behavior in FB_Task:
- ST_Recipe DUT defined (recipeID INT, ingredientType INT, ingredientRatio REAL, productionTemperature REAL).
- recipe: ARRAY[1..10] OF ST_Recipe as VAR_IN_OUT (caller-persistent).
- Rising-edge detection on queryRecipe/addRecipe/deleteRecipe/modifyRecipe via retained edge flags.
- Outputs recipeAdded/recipeDeleted/recipeModified are one-scan pulses; error and status default to FALSE/0 each invocation (cleared on idle).
- Query: missing ID -> error, status 16#8001; else recipeQueryResult := matched record.
- Add: duplicate checked first -> 16#8002; then full -> 16#8003; otherwise written to the lowest-index empty slot (recipeID=0) and recipeAdded pulse.
- Delete: missing -> 16#8004; else only recipeID set to 0 and recipeDeleted pulse.
- Modify: missing -> 16#8005; else full record replaced and recipeModified pulse.
- Failed requests never mutate the database; ID uniqueness and lowest-slot insertion are preserved.

Compilation verified only; no PLC functional/hardware tests were executed.
